PR #37928 implements the architecture we discussed in the #mathlib4 > Unbundling Γ from Computability.Encoding thread.

I've unbundled Γ from Encoding and completely removed the FinEncoding structure (replaced by [Fintype Γ] where needed).

Surprisingly, the typeclass inference handled almost everything automatically! Besides the core Computability.Encoding file, I only had to fix one downstream file (Mathlib.ModelTheory.Encoding). All CI checks are green.
